title: Induce, Align, Predict: Zero-Shot Stance Detection via Cognitive Inductive Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of the Cognitive Inductive Reasoning Framework (CIRF) for zero-shot stance detection. While the experimental datasets include topics with moral or ethical dimensions (e.g., legalization of abortion), the paper's primary aim is methodological improvement in NLP, not the evaluation of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
